record.segment: Public community college; 5,000–9,999 credit students annually; Massachusetts/New England
facts_carried_over: Jessica Correia is Executive Director of Enrollment Services in Student Services and Enrollment Management and serves on the President's Cabinet. Source: Massasoit Community College faculty/staff directory and Senior Leadership & President's Cabinet pages, crawled 2026-09-14.

Massasoit's 2024-2029 strategic plan assigns Enrollment Management responsibility for demographic enrollment and retention trend analysis and data supporting retention process changes. Source: Massasoit Equitable Enrollment and Student Support page, crawled 2026-09-11.
Board materials set goals to increase overall enrollment to 6,000 and fall-to-fall retention to at least 60.5%. Source: Massasoit Board of Trustees minutes, 2024-05-15.
Massasoit reported 5,684 credit students on 2025-09-03, up 18% year over year, before final census. Source: Massasoit news release, 2025-09-03.
Publicly documented systems include Ellucian Banner/Self-Service Banner, Canvas, and Degree Works. Source: Massasoit Degree Works and Online Learning pages, crawled 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-15.
